title: Avalon rules
description: Editor reference for Avalon's authored rules. Hover over fields for help; use Ctrl+Space for values and block templates.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema association; this project already configures it in .vscode/settings.json.

sources.description: Source names and abbreviations used by citations, filters and Browse.

rules.description: Top-level h1 blocks define chapters, with introductory text and nested rules in entries. Named h1-h6 headings and boxes inside them become individual rules by default; rule: false keeps a block inline. Source, page and kind are inherited.

id.description: Unique source id, such as PC1 or GMC.

name.description: Full name, such as Player Core.

source.description: Optional short abbreviation shown in lists and filters; defaults to id.

defaultSnippets.label: Chapter
defaultSnippets.description: A chapter with introductory text, a rule and a nested section. Source and kind are inherited.

defaultSnippets.label: Standalone rule
defaultSnippets.description: A rule outside a chapter block.

type.description: Named h1-h6 headings and boxes can become nested rules.

enumDescriptions: A chapter at the top level; otherwise the largest content heading.
A secondary section inside a box.
A displayed calculation with optional label.
A bullet, numbered or plain list.
A labeled line, optionally with hanging indentation.
A table with optional caption and column names.
An action or feat stat block.
A spell stat block with casting details and heightened effects.
type.description: Content block style. Omit for a generic text section.

id.description: Optional stable id, unique within its source. If omitted, generated from ruleName or name: lowercase, accents and punctuation removed, words joined by hyphens. Duplicate names add their page number (areas-300); repeated name/page combinations also add the source (areas-300-pc1). Missing pages use no-page; further collisions add a number. Set an explicit id to preserve links and stars when renaming or changing page numbers.

name.description: Heading displayed in the parent text. Inline tags such as {@as 1} are supported.

rule.description: Named h1-h6 headings and boxes become rules by default, except a top-level h1 which defines a chapter. Set false to keep a heading or box inline only. Other block types cannot become rules; their eligible children can. No id is required.

ruleName.description: Optional catalog and hover title, also used to generate the id when none is provided. For example use Degree of Success here while name stays Step 4: Degree of Success in the parent.

ruleDefault.description: Prefer this definition when resolving a rule link by name. Otherwise, duplicate names are ambiguous: use a page-based target such as {@rule areas-300|PC1|Areas}. The Watch rule links editor task reports ambiguous references in the JSON and Problems panel on save. A source in the tag restricts matching to that source.

aliases.description: Alternative names used by name search and {@rule ...} links.

source.description: Source id or abbreviation from sources. Nested blocks inherit it; an omitted top-level source defaults to Avalon.

chapter.description: Optional chapter for standalone rules. A top-level h1 automatically uses its name as the chapter; nested blocks inherit it while the source stays the same.

page.description: Printed source page. Inherits from the parent; omitted on citations for original setting material.

kind.description: Catalog type: core, optional or setting. On ability blocks this is the printed label, such as Feat.

enumDescriptions: Original Avalon material; not attributed to a published page.
setting.description: Adds an Avalon provenance note. Nested blocks inherit this marker.

settingNote.description: Optional explanation shown in the Avalon provenance note. Inline tags are supported.

entries.description: Paragraphs and nested blocks, in display order. Each string is one paragraph.

entry.description: A single paragraph or content block. Use entries for several paragraphs.

items.description: List items. Use type item with name and style hanging for bold labels and wrapped text.

style.description: List numbering, plain lines, hanging labels, or a two-column dialogue table.

columns.description: List column count (2 or more). Items flow down each column, then across. Columns reduce automatically in narrow readers and previews, and stack on small screens. Works with bullet, numbered and plain lists.

ordered.description: Number list items instead of using bullets.

caption.description: Table title, displayed above the column names.

footnotes.description: Optional notes below the table rows, inside the table block. Use a string or an array of notes; inline formatting and links are supported.

colLabels.description: Column names, in the same order as the cells in each row.

rows.description: Table rows. Each row is an array of cells in column order.

open.description: On a clarification, true starts expanded. Omit or false to start collapsed.

actions.description: Action symbol: 1, 2, 3, r for reaction or f for free action. Omit for a passive ability.

level.description: Ability or spell level. Text such as Level is allowed for examples.

traits.description: Trait labels displayed beneath the ability or spell title.

compact.description: Use the condensed inline ability layout with hanging text.

access.description: Ability access. Accepts text or an array of paragraphs and blocks.

prerequisites.description: Ability prerequisites. Accepts text or an array of paragraphs and blocks.

frequency.description: Ability frequency. Accepts text or an array of paragraphs and blocks.

trigger.description: Ability trigger. Accepts text or an array of paragraphs and blocks.

requirements.description: Ability requirements. Accepts text or an array of paragraphs and blocks.

cost.description: Ability cost. Accepts text or an array of paragraphs and blocks.

effect.description: Ability description; overrides entries when present.

special.description: Ability special. Accepts text or an array of paragraphs and blocks.

href.description: Image path such as img/icons/example.webp, or an object with path or url.

url.description: Alternative image URL when href is omitted.

align.description: For image blocks: right shows a small thumbnail with text wrapping beside it. Clicking any image opens the zoomable viewer. Place the image before the text it should sit beside.

title.description: Image caption. Use name for headings and caption for tables.

spellType.description: Printed spell classification beside its level; defaults to Spell.

traditions.description: Magical traditions. An array is displayed as a comma-separated list. A non-empty domain replaces this field.

cast.description: Casting actions or time. Use 1, 2, 3, r or f for action symbols; longer text such as 1 minute or {@as 2} (concentrate, manipulate) is also supported.

area.description: Area affected by the spell, when applicable.

targets.description: Creatures or objects the spell can affect.

savingThrow.description: Legacy name for defense. Use defense for new spell blocks.

duration.description: How long the spell lasts. Omit for an instantaneous spell.

heightened.description: Heightened effects, displayed after the spell description, in authored order.

level.description: Heightened rank or increment, such as 3, +1 or Level.

entries.description: Heightened effect text, paragraphs or other blocks.

entry.description: Single heightened effect; alternative to entries.

domain.description: Domain or domains of a domain spell. When non-empty, displayed instead of Traditions.

defense.description: Defense against the spell, such as basic Reflex, Will or AC. Shown on the same line as Duration.

kind.description: Printed ability classification, such as Feat or Action. This is separate from the inherited catalog type.

defaultSnippets.label: Image with viewer
defaultSnippets.description: A right-aligned thumbnail. Put it before the text it should sit beside; click to enlarge, zoom and pan.

defaultSnippets.label: Heading
defaultSnippets.description: A heading and its text. Named h1-h6 headings become rules; a top-level h1 defines a chapter. Use rule: false to keep a heading inline.

defaultSnippets.label: Inline-only heading
defaultSnippets.description: A heading kept in its parent's text without a separate rule entry.

defaultSnippets.label: Nested rule
defaultSnippets.description: A heading or box that also appears independently in the rules list.

defaultSnippets.label: Box
defaultSnippets.description: An inset box that also appears in the rules list. Use rule: false for an inline-only box.

defaultSnippets.label: Box section
defaultSnippets.description: A secondary title inside an existing box.

defaultSnippets.label: Table
defaultSnippets.description: A titled table with column names, rows and optional footnotes.

defaultSnippets.label: List
defaultSnippets.description: Bullet points. Use list-decimal for numbering or list-no-bullets for plain lines.

defaultSnippets.label: Multi-column list
defaultSnippets.description: A list in two or more columns. Add style list-no-bullets for plain lines.

defaultSnippets.label: Plain list
defaultSnippets.description: Compact lines with list formatting and no bullet points.

defaultSnippets.label: Degree of success list
defaultSnippets.description: Critical Success, Success, Failure and Critical Failure with hanging labels.

defaultSnippets.label: Paizo clarification
defaultSnippets.description: A clarification that starts collapsed.

defaultSnippets.label: Formula
defaultSnippets.description: A calculation with an optional small label.

defaultSnippets.label: Flavor text
defaultSnippets.description: Centered flavor text with ornamental separators.

defaultSnippets.label: Ability
defaultSnippets.description: An action or feat stat block with prerequisites and effect text.

defaultSnippets.label: Spell
defaultSnippets.description: A spell stat block with traditions or domain, casting, targeting, defense, duration and heightened effects. Related fields share a line; omit inapplicable fields.

defaultSnippets.label: Compact ability
defaultSnippets.description: An inline ability with hanging text and labeled fields.

rowSpan.description: Rows this cell spans. Leave this column out of the following covered rows; do not add empty placeholders.

colSpan.description: Columns this cell spans. Do not add cells for the covered columns.

rowHeader.description: Render this cell as a bold row header; useful for grouped labels such as Bird or Dog.

defaultSnippets.label: Merged row label
defaultSnippets.description: A group label covering two rows. Omit this cell from the next covered row.
